// diagnostic

E1247

Registry `{registry}` requires signed packages (`require_signed: true`) but `{name}` {version} has no signature.

What

Registry `{registry}` requires signed packages (`require_signed: true`) but `{name}` {version} has no signature.

Why

The registry is configured to accept only author-signed releases; an unsigned entry can't be trusted under that policy (D-PKGSIGN1).

Fix

use a different registry, or ask the package author to publish a signed release (`jet registry publish` auto-signs by default — they likely used `--no-sign`).
